decisions.reason: The hearty bread is a low-cost addition close to the core range and has no disappointing results to explain, so there is no pressure to drop it, though bakery assortments rotate easily because little is invested.

The historic mill tour builds on the firm's heritage facilities and event business and is a visible, publicly promoted part of its experiential identity, so dropping it would write off that commitment and contradict the heritage positioning it announced.
The sweet pastry needed little investment and fits the established craft range, and with no evidence of failure the firm would likely keep it, although such items are easily swapped out.
